apps/loom/src/tooling/dev/coordinator.ts:87-93 increments the revision, aborts the running controller, clears pending work and restarts the debounce timer on every invalidation. With RPC diagnostics written every 50ms, the default 75ms timer cannot admit a saved edit until traffic pauses.
